title: [Audit] 👤 Identity 360
description: One identity’s complete footprint — pick someone in Identity in the control bar and every panel becomes their story.

config.content:
### Everything one person did, on one page

Use it to check whether their activity is normal, see what they changed and read, and gather evidence for a review or investigation. Raw records: [All audit events](/app/discover#/view/cloud-audit-search-all-events), [Raw signal feed](/app/discover#/view/cloud-audit-search-raw-signal-feed).

**How to use it:** pick someone in the Identity control, or click a Principal id in a table; with nobody selected, the page covers everyone. ① *Is this normal?* always looks at the last 7 days in UTC, ② *What they did* follows the time picker, and ③ *Evidence* ends in the raw records. Table times are in your time zone.

- Pick an Identity type first to shorten the Identity list. A person’s API keys are identities of their own, so their traffic never counts under the person.
- The ① panels read a fixed 7 days with no noise gate, so they will not match the Events tile or the time picker.
- Baseline: the band is their usual range for each hour; with under three days of history no band is drawn.
- The Risk tile and Every scoring action count whole minutes only, so they can stop up to a minute short of the panels around them.
- Session timeline: click a bar to pin a session and zoom to it (Elasticsearch panels then read empty); the browser’s Back button returns to the previous time range, and removing the pill shows every session again. API-only identities have no sessions.
- Identities read as in the Identity dropdown, a Cloud API key shortened to “_4KEO… · Cloud API key”, with the Identity type badge beside each. The dropdowns apply to this page only; the links above do not carry them.
